observations: All displayed rates, 2021-to-2023 percentage-point changes, and delivered comparison CSV observations match the oracle.
The year controls work, the page includes a district head-to-head tool, and the progress matrix visibly preserves the requested Gaya and Nalanda changes.
The agent correctly says that the aggregate synthetic file cannot explain why Gaya is below Nalanda.
The requested comparison CSV was delivered as a separate file, but the page's Export CSV button exports its current selected year rather than the final multi-year Gaya/Nalanda comparison.
The page invents a 70% benchmark and Needs Focus / Priority interpretation that the supplied data does not define.
Workshop-online desktop presentation is polished, legible, information-rich and interactive. The page is 408 px wider than the 390 px viewport and its wide tables clip on narrow screens.
The page depends on Tailwind and Chart.js CDNs; the offline-resilience pass reports tailwind is not defined and is visually degraded.
The five turns took 284.821 seconds. Model-resolution logs confirm Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).
evidence_notes: deterministic-online-calibration-bug.json is retained but superseded: its numeric matcher rejected 66.00% when expecting 66.0%. The corrected deterministic-online.json accepts equivalent decimal formatting.
The score is unblinded and provisional until paired review; deterministic correctness and critical-failure findings are not delegated to a visual judge.
